channel.title: Remote Work Notes
channel.description: Working well from home, with less noise and more focus.

item.title: Can You Deduct a Home Office if You Work Remotely?
item.description: What IRS guidance says about who can claim the home office deduction, why most remote employees cannot, and how the $5 per square foot option works.

item.title: How to Spot a Work-From-Home Job Scam
item.description: The warning signs of fake remote job offers, from crypto deposits to fake interviews, based on FBI alerts, plus what to do if you already paid.

item.title: How Common Is Remote Work? What the Data Shows
item.description: A look at official US labor data on how many people work from home, broken down by education level and gender, with no product recommendations.

item.title: Keeping Work Data Secure on a Home Network
item.description: A plain-language summary of CISA and NIST telework security guidance covering home Wi-Fi, device use, and the behaviors that create the most risk.

item.title: Setting Up a Home Office, What Ergonomics Guidance Says
item.description: What official US workplace health guidance on ergonomics recommends for a home office setup, with no product endorsements.

item.title: What Federal Telework Agreements Say About Communication Boundaries
item.description: How the US government's own telework guidance defines communication expectations in writing, and how to borrow that structure for any remote job.
